name: now_ms
semantics: Monotonic high-resolution milliseconds.

name: epoch_ms
semantics: Unix epoch milliseconds.

name: random_f64
semantics: Uniform pseudo-random f64 in [0,1).

name: random_u32
semantics: Pseudo-random 32-bit value.

name: get_view_width
semantics: Current runtime viewport width.

name: get_view_height
semantics: Current runtime viewport height.

name: get_dpr
semantics: Current device pixel ratio.

name: request_redraw
semantics: Marks the runtime framebuffer dirty for redraw.

name: set_cursor
semantics: Select host cursor by stable numeric id.

name: log_utf8
semantics: Writes UTF-8 text to the host runtime console.

name: log_i32
semantics: Writes one integer to the host runtime console.

name: log_f64
semantics: Writes one floating-point value to the host runtime console.

name: set_window_title
semantics: Changes the running app window title.

name: storage_set
semantics: Global persistent key/value storage shared through the host.

name: storage_get
semantics: Reads a global persistent value into WASM memory.

name: storage_size
semantics: Returns stored value byte size or negative on error.

name: storage_delete
semantics: Deletes a global persistent value.

name: fs_mkdir
semantics: Creates a shared virtual directory.

name: fs_write
semantics: Writes/replaces a shared virtual file.

name: fs_read
semantics: Synchronously reads from the host shared in-memory VFS.

name: fs_size
semantics: Returns virtual file byte size.

name: fs_exists
semantics: Tests virtual path existence.

name: fs_delete
semantics: Deletes virtual path.

name: fs_rename
semantics: Renames virtual path.

name: host_fs_mount_picker
semantics: Opens a directory picker. Completion callback: hostFsMounted(success).

name: host_fs_read
semantics: LEGACY asynchronous whole-file read. Return means request accepted, not bytes ready. Completion callback: hostFsReadDone(bytes) / hostFsReadDoneEx(opId,bytes,status). Prefer Resource API for new apps.

name: host_fs_write
semantics: Asynchronously writes a file in the mounted directory. Completion callback: hostFsWriteDone(bytes).

name: net_listen
semantics: Starts a shared localhost virtual HTTP listener.

name: net_poll_request
semantics: Polls one virtual-local-network request.

name: net_accept
semantics: Reads a queued virtual local request payload.

name: net_send_response
semantics: Updates virtual localhost response bytes.

name: net_open_external_browser
semantics: Opens the virtual localhost service in a real browser tab.

name: net_fetch
semantics: Legacy virtual-network fetch helper; synchronous return cannot await remote work. Prefer HTTP Bridge.

name: http_request
semantics: Starts an outbound HTTP request and returns the exact request id. Poll status/size then read response; optional httpResponse callback.

name: http_get_status
semantics: Returns 0 pending, positive HTTP status, negative transport error.

name: http_get_response_size
semantics: Returns buffered HTTP response byte size.

name: http_read_response
semantics: Copies buffered HTTP response into WASM memory.

name: socket_capabilities
semantics: Returns raw packet transport capability mask. No HTTP/TLS parsing is performed by the OS.

name: tcp_connect
semantics: Opens an owner-bound raw TCP byte stream. Host resolves/connects only; HTTP/TLS framing remains entirely in WASM.

name: tcp_state
semantics: Returns socket state.

name: tcp_send
semantics: Writes opaque bytes to the owner-bound TCP stream; OS does not inspect protocol contents.

name: tcp_receive
semantics: Copies opaque received TCP bytes into owner WASM memory; OS does not parse TLS/HTTP.

name: tcp_pending
semantics: Returns pending receive byte count.

name: tcp_close
semantics: Closes socket.

name: tcp_error_size
semantics: Returns socket error UTF-8 size.

name: tcp_read_error
semantics: Reads socket error text.

name: ipc_write
semantics: Legacy last-value shared channel. Prefer Service Fabric.

name: ipc_read
semantics: Reads legacy shared channel.

name: ipc_peek
semantics: Returns legacy channel byte count.

name: usb_request_device
semantics: Requests/open WebUSB device.

name: usb_transfer_out
semantics: Submits USB OUT transfer.

name: usb_transfer_in
semantics: Submits USB IN transfer; usbDataReceived callback.

name: serial_request_port
semantics: Requests and opens a WebSerial port.

name: serial_write
semantics: Queues bytes to serial writer.

name: serial_read
semantics: Reads host-buffered serial bytes if available.

name: hid_send_report
semantics: Sends HID output report when a HID device is available.

name: ble_request_device
semantics: Requests BLE device/service.

name: ble_write
semantics: Writes BLE characteristic.

name: ble_read
semantics: Starts BLE characteristic read.

name: gamepad_count
semantics: Returns connected gamepad count.

name: gamepad_get_state
semantics: Writes normalized gamepad state to WASM memory.

name: geo_get_position
semantics: Writes latest geolocation values.

name: motion_get_orientation
semantics: Writes latest device orientation values.

name: media_start_camera
semantics: Starts camera capture through host MediaDevices.

name: media_get_video_frame
semantics: Copies latest camera RGBA frame into WASM.

name: media_get_mic_fft
semantics: Copies latest microphone FFT bins.

name: audio_play_pcm
semantics: Plays PCM audio through WebAudio.

name: audio_tone
semantics: Synthesizes a host audio tone.

name: video_decoder_init
semantics: Initializes hardware/browser video decoder.

name: video_decoder_decode
semantics: Submits encoded video chunk to WebCodecs.

name: video_draw_to_framebuffer
semantics: Copies latest decoded/direct video frame into WASM framebuffer region.

name: ws_connect
semantics: Connects WebSocket or local WHEP/HLS stream abstraction.

name: ws_send
semantics: Sends WebSocket bytes when applicable.

name: ws_receive
semantics: Reads queued WebSocket bytes.

name: ws_close
semantics: Closes WebSocket/WHEP/HLS record.

name: stream_stats_poll
semantics: Refreshes cached real WebRTC telemetry asynchronously.

name: stream_stat
semantics: Reads cached stream telemetry metric.

name: ai_init
semantics: Initializes local ONNX Runtime Web vision subsystem.

name: ai_pick_model
semantics: Picks YOLO/OSNet ONNX model file.

name: ai_pick_reference
semantics: Picks reference image.

name: ai_set_enabled
semantics: Arms/disarms AI side-band processing.

name: ai_set_config
semantics: Sets vision scheduler/model configuration.

name: ai_reid_submit
semantics: Queues one person crop for ReID.

name: ai_save_match
semantics: Persists one AI result snapshot.

name: ai_discard_result
semantics: Discards pending ReID result.

name: ai_snapshot_draw
semantics: Draws stored snapshot into WASM framebuffer.

name: ai_reference_draw
semantics: Draws reference image into WASM framebuffer.

name: ai_snapshot_info
semantics: Reads snapshot metric.

name: ai_snapshot_clear
semantics: Clears stored snapshots.

name: ai_stat
semantics: Reads local vision telemetry metric.

name: clipboard_write
semantics: Writes UTF-8 text to clipboard when permitted.

name: clipboard_size
semantics: Returns last clipboard text byte size.

name: clipboard_read
semantics: Reads cached clipboard text.

name: download_bytes
semantics: Legacy one-shot download. Requires complete payload in WASM memory.

name: unicode_text_draw
semantics: Rasterizes UTF-8 Unicode text through the browser shaping engine directly into a WASM RGBA framebuffer. flags: bit0 force RTL, bit1 wrap, bit2 bold, bit3 monospace, bit4 auto-direction. Returns rendered pixel height or negative error.

name: resource_pick_file
semantics: Creates a resource handle and opens a browser file picker. Handle state becomes READY asynchronously. Callback: resourceOpened(handle,state,sizeLo,sizeHi).

name: resource_open_url
semantics: Creates an HTTP(S) random-access resource handle without buffering the whole object. HEAD/Range discovers size.

name: resource_open_mounted
semantics: Opens a file from the mounted physical directory as a random-access resource.

name: resource_open_vfs
semantics: Opens a shared VFS file as a random-access resource.

name: resource_state
semantics: Resource state: 0 opening, 1 ready, 2 closed, negative error.

name: resource_size_lo
semantics: Low 32 bits of resource byte length.

name: resource_size_hi
semantics: High 32 bits of resource byte length.

name: resource_name_size
semantics: UTF-8 resource display-name byte size.

name: resource_read_name
semantics: Reads UTF-8 resource display name.

name: resource_error_size
semantics: UTF-8 resource error byte size.

name: resource_read_error
semantics: Reads resource error text.

name: resource_read_range
semantics: Starts an asynchronous random-access read directly into the supplied WASM linear-memory range. Buffer must remain valid until resourceReadDone. Returns request id.

name: resource_request_status
semantics: Read request status: 0 pending, 1 complete, negative error.

name: resource_request_bytes
semantics: Completed bytes written by a range read.

name: resource_request_release
semantics: Releases completed/cancelled read-request bookkeeping. New apps should release each request after observing completion.

name: resource_cancel
semantics: Cancels a pending range read when possible.

name: resource_close
semantics: Closes a resource handle and cancels its pending reads.

name: download_begin
semantics: Begins host-managed chunked download/save stream and returns stream id. WASM need not hold the full output contiguously.

name: download_write
semantics: Copies one chunk from WASM into the host download stream. Returns accepted bytes.

name: download_end
semantics: Finalizes and saves/downloads the stream. Callback: downloadEvent(id,state,bytesLo,bytesHi).

name: download_abort
semantics: Aborts a chunked download stream.

name: download_state
semantics: Returns stream state: 0 open, 1 finalizing, 2 done, negative error.

name: app_instance_id_size
semantics: Returns UTF-8 byte size of this runtime instance id.

name: app_read_instance_id
semantics: Reads this runtime instance id.

name: app_tab_name_size
semantics: Returns UTF-8 byte size of source tab/app name.

name: app_read_tab_name
semantics: Reads source tab/app name.

name: svc_register
semantics: Publishes a versioned service owned by this runtime; returns service id. Auto-unregistered when runtime stops.

name: svc_unregister
semantics: Unpublishes one owned service.

name: svc_provider_count
semantics: Returns live provider count for a service name.

name: svc_find_provider
semantics: Returns service id for indexed live provider.

name: svc_service_flags
semantics: Returns provider service flags.

name: svc_service_version_size
semantics: Returns provider version UTF-8 size.

name: svc_read_service_version
semantics: Reads provider version string.

name: svc_request
semantics: Routes an asynchronous request to one live provider using round-robin. Returns correlation/request id. Provider callback: serviceRequest(requestId,serviceId,methodBytes,payloadBytes).

name: svc_request_provider
semantics: Targets one discovered service provider id/version explicitly. Returns correlation/request id or a negative service state.

name: svc_request_method_size
semantics: Returns incoming request method byte size.

name: svc_request_read_method
semantics: Provider reads incoming request method.

name: svc_request_payload_size
semantics: Returns incoming request payload byte size.

name: svc_request_read_payload
semantics: Provider reads incoming request payload.

name: svc_request_status
semantics: Returns request state: 0 pending, 1 streaming, 2 complete, negative error/cancel/timeout.

name: svc_request_release
semantics: Client releases completed/cancelled request state and buffered chunks/response. Pending requests cannot be released; cancel first.

name: svc_respond
semantics: Provider sends final response. Client callback: serviceResponse(requestId,status,payloadBytes).

name: svc_response_size
semantics: Returns final response byte size.

name: svc_response_read
semantics: Client reads final response bytes.

name: svc_respond_chunk
semantics: Provider emits streaming response chunk. flag bit0=FINAL. Returns accepted bytes, -2 when per-request host backpressure limit is reached. Client callback: serviceChunk(requestId,flags,bytes,pendingChunks).

name: svc_chunk_pending
semantics: Returns queued unread response chunks.

name: svc_chunk_size
semantics: Returns next queued chunk byte size.

name: svc_chunk_flags
semantics: Returns flags for next queued chunk.

name: svc_chunk_read
semantics: Reads and consumes next response chunk.

name: svc_cancel
semantics: Cancels an owned request; provider callback: serviceCancelled(requestId,reason).

name: svc_subscribe
semantics: Subscribes to provider events by service name and topic; topic * is wildcard. Returns subscription id.

name: svc_unsubscribe
semantics: Removes subscription.

name: svc_emit
semantics: Provider broadcasts event to matching subscribers. Subscriber callback: serviceEvent(eventId,subscriptionId,topicBytes,payloadBytes).

name: svc_event_topic_size
semantics: Returns event topic byte size.

name: svc_event_read_topic
semantics: Reads event topic bytes.

name: svc_event_payload_size
semantics: Returns event payload byte size.

name: svc_event_read_payload
semantics: Reads event payload bytes.

name: svc_event_ack
semantics: Acknowledges/removes one delivered event payload.

name: compute_capabilities
semantics: Generic compute capability bitmask. bit0=WebAssembly SIMD128 build path, bit1=SharedArrayBuffer available, bit2=crossOriginIsolated, bit3=WebGPU API present, bit4=multiple logical hardware threads reported. Capability discovery only; applications must still handle runtime failures.

name: compute_hardware_threads
semantics: Returns navigator.hardwareConcurrency when available, otherwise 1. Useful for scheduling and telemetry; does not itself create threads.

name: compute_device_memory_mb
semantics: Approximate device-memory hint in MiB from navigator.deviceMemory when exposed; returns 0 when unavailable. This is a coarse browser hint, not an allocation guarantee.

name: svc_set_manifest
semantics: Stores opaque UTF-8/JSON provider manifest bytes for developer discovery. The Host does not interpret application schema fields.

name: svc_manifest_size
semantics: Returns service manifest byte size, or negative if unavailable.

name: svc_read_manifest
semantics: Reads provider manifest bytes into WASM memory.

name: svc_set_load
semantics: Provider publishes current load/queue/capacity/latency telemetry. Used for least-loaded routing; values are advisory.

name: svc_provider_metric
semantics: Reads provider metric: 1 active, 2 queued, 3 capacity, 4 EWMA ms, 5 age ms, 6 health(1/0).

name: svc_request_ex
semantics: Extended service request with priority and opaque flags. Host selects a healthy least-loaded provider; callback semantics match svc_request.

name: svc_request_provider_ex
semantics: Extended request targeted at one exact provider.

name: svc_request_priority
semantics: Provider reads normalized request priority 0..100.

name: svc_request_flags
semantics: Provider reads opaque request flags supplied by caller.

name: app_stable_id_size
semantics: Returns stable installed-app identifier byte size. Unlike runtime instance id, this survives restart/workspace restore.

name: app_read_stable_id
semantics: Reads stable installed-app identifier UTF-8 bytes.

name: app_manifest_set
semantics: Publishes the application semantic manifest (wasmos.app/1 JSON): role, summary, kind, permissions, provides/requires, intents, lifecycle and composition hints. Host validates/normalizes it and exposes it to Gemini/system graph.

name: app_manifest_size
semantics: Returns normalized semantic app manifest UTF-8 byte size.

name: app_manifest_read
semantics: Reads normalized semantic app manifest JSON.

name: app_ready
semantics: Publishes lifecycle readiness. state 0=starting, 1=ready, -1=degraded, -2=failed. Microservice verification requires READY.

name: app_health_set
semantics: Publishes structured health state and diagnostic message to OS supervisor/service graph.

name: app_heartbeat
semantics: Refreshes cooperative process heartbeat and optional work/progress telemetry.

name: app_restart_policy
semantics: Sets OS restart policy: 0=never,1=on-fault,2=always; bounded by maxRestarts/window. Host may quarantine crash loops.

name: permission_query
semantics: Returns OS grant state for one capability: 1=allowed, 0=ask/unset, -1=denied. Browser-level permission may still require user gesture.

name: permission_request
semantics: Starts asynchronous OS permission request and returns request id. Completion callback permissionDecision(requestId,state).

name: permission_revoke
semantics: Revokes this app OS-level capability grant immediately.

name: permission_policy_size
semantics: Returns effective permission policy JSON byte size: declared, observed, granted, denied and pending.

name: permission_policy_read
semantics: Reads effective permission policy JSON.

name: app_storage_set
semantics: Writes app-private persistent bytes namespaced by stable app id. Preferred over legacy global storage.

name: app_storage_get
semantics: Reads app-private persistent bytes.

name: app_storage_size
semantics: Returns app-private value byte size.

name: app_storage_delete
semantics: Deletes app-private persistent value.

name: app_fs_mkdir
semantics: Creates directory inside /appdata/<stable-app-id>/; path traversal outside sandbox is rejected.

name: app_fs_write
semantics: Writes file inside app-private VFS sandbox.

name: app_fs_read
semantics: Reads file inside app-private VFS sandbox.

name: app_fs_size
semantics: Returns app-private VFS file size.

name: app_fs_exists
semantics: Tests path existence inside app-private VFS sandbox.

name: app_fs_delete
semantics: Deletes path inside app-private VFS sandbox.

name: secret_set
semantics: Stores an ephemeral non-portable secret in OS memory. Secrets are intentionally excluded from workspace JSON.

name: secret_size
semantics: Returns ephemeral secret byte size.

name: secret_read
semantics: Reads app-scoped ephemeral secret bytes; requires credential.vault permission.

name: secret_delete
semantics: Deletes app-scoped ephemeral secret.

name: svc_contract_set
semantics: Publishes validated wasmos.service/1 contract JSON including methods, JSON schemas, events, idempotency and optional WIT text.

name: svc_contract_size
semantics: Returns service contract JSON byte size.

name: svc_contract_read
semantics: Reads normalized service contract JSON.

name: svc_provider_count_compatible
semantics: Counts live providers whose semantic version satisfies range (*, exact, ^major.minor.patch, ~major.minor.patch, >=x.y.z).

name: svc_find_provider_compatible
semantics: Returns compatible provider id by index.

name: svc_request_compatible
semantics: Extended request with semantic-version range; OS chooses healthy least-loaded compatible provider.

name: svc_dependency_declare
semantics: Declares runtime dependency edge from this app to a service/version range. flags bit0=optional, bit1=startup-critical.

name: svc_dependency_status
semantics: Returns dependency status: 1=satisfied, 0=missing, -1=unknown/removed.

name: os_graph_snapshot_size
semantics: Returns UTF-8 JSON size of caller-filtered live OS graph: installed apps, manifests, services, dependencies, health and permission summaries.

name: os_graph_snapshot_read
semantics: Reads live OS graph JSON. Secrets and private data are never included.

name: os_capability_catalog_size
semantics: Returns machine-readable capability catalog JSON byte size generated from the same ABI registry Gemini receives.

name: os_capability_catalog_read
semantics: Reads machine-readable capability/permission catalog JSON.

name: notify_post
semantics: Posts OS notification and returns notification id. severity 0=info,1=success,2=warning,3=error.

name: notify_remove
semantics: Removes one OS notification.

name: net_transport_capabilities
semantics: Raw transport capabilities: bit0 TCP, bit1 Direct Sockets, bit2 native host, bit3 stream IO, bit4 UDP. Transport never parses application protocols.

name: net_transport_info_size
semantics: Returns byte size of transport diagnostics JSON (backend, IWA/direct-socket availability, packet ownership guarantees).

name: net_transport_info_read
semantics: Reads transport diagnostics JSON. Contains no payload data and performs no protocol parsing.

name: tcp_set_receive_limit
semantics: Sets owner socket receive backpressure limit; returns accepted byte limit.

name: udp_open
semantics: Opens owner-bound connected UDP datagram transport through Direct Sockets/native bridge. Payload remains opaque.

name: udp_state
semantics: Returns owner UDP socket state.

name: udp_send
semantics: Sends one opaque UDP datagram.

name: udp_receive
semantics: Reads one opaque UDP datagram payload into WASM memory.

name: udp_pending
semantics: Returns queued UDP payload bytes for owner socket.

name: udp_close
semantics: Closes owner UDP socket.

name: udp_error_size
semantics: Returns UTF-8 UDP transport error size.

name: udp_read_error
semantics: Reads UDP transport error text.

name: crypto_capabilities
semantics: Returns audited primitive capability bits: CSPRNG, P-256 ECDH, AES-128-GCM, SPKI signature verification and public trust anchors. No TLS parsing occurs in the OS.

name: crypto_random
semantics: Fills owner memory with CSPRNG bytes from Web Crypto getRandomValues.

name: crypto_p256_generate
semantics: Starts owner-bound ephemeral P-256 ECDH key generation. Result is key id (u32 BE) plus uncompressed public point.

name: crypto_p256_derive
semantics: Starts ECDH deriveBits using an owner key handle and peer SEC1 public point.

name: crypto_key_release
semantics: Destroys an owner-bound non-exported cryptographic key handle.

name: crypto_aes_gcm_encrypt
semantics: Starts AES-128-GCM seal over caller-owned bytes and returns ciphertext with 128-bit tag.

name: crypto_aes_gcm_decrypt
semantics: Starts authenticated AES-128-GCM open. Authentication failure is an operation error with no plaintext.

name: crypto_verify_spki
semantics: Starts signature verification using DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo. 1/2/3 are RSA-PSS, ECDSA and RSA-PKCS1 with SHA-256; 4/5/6 are SHA-384; 7/8/9 are RSA-PKCS1, RSA-PSS and ECDSA with SHA-512.

name: crypto_op_state
semantics: Returns owner crypto operation state: 0 pending, 1 complete, negative error.

name: crypto_op_size
semantics: Returns completed crypto result size.

name: crypto_op_read
semantics: Copies a completed owner crypto result into WASM memory.

name: crypto_op_error_size
semantics: Returns owner crypto operation error text size.

name: crypto_op_read_error
semantics: Reads owner crypto operation error text.

name: crypto_op_release
semantics: Zeroes and releases an owner crypto operation result.

name: trust_anchor_count
semantics: Returns bundled public root count. The WASM application remains responsible for X.509 path and hostname validation.

name: trust_anchor_size
semantics: Returns DER byte size for one public root certificate.

name: trust_anchor_read
semantics: Copies one DER public root certificate; no validation decision is made by the OS.

name: ct_log_count
semantics: Returns the bundled public Certificate Transparency log metadata count; the WASM application verifies SCT signatures and policy.

name: ct_log_id_read
semantics: Copies the 32-byte public CT log id for one metadata entry.

name: ct_log_key_size
semantics: Returns DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo size for one public CT log.

name: ct_log_key_read
semantics: Copies DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for one public CT log; no SCT decision is made by the OS.

name: ct_log_operator
semantics: Returns a stable operator identifier used by WASM CT diversity policy.

name: ct_log_start_ms
semantics: Returns the inclusive temporal interval start for a CT log, or zero.

name: ct_log_end_ms
semantics: Returns the exclusive temporal interval end for a CT log, or zero.

name: ct_log_state
semantics: Returns public CT log state: 1 usable, 2 qualified, 3 readonly, 0 unsupported/retired.

name: log
semantics: Legacy numeric logging compatibility import; prefer log_i32/log_utf8.

name: console_log
semantics: Legacy UTF-8 console logging compatibility import; prefer log_utf8.

name: js_realm_create
semantics: Creates a network-denied ECMAScript worker realm owned by the calling WASM runtime.

name: js_realm_set_dom
semantics: Replaces the realm virtual DOM snapshot. The realm has no independent network capability.

name: js_realm_eval
semantics: Queues ECMAScript evaluation in the network-denied realm and returns a job id.

name: js_realm_dispatch
semantics: Dispatches an owner-approved DOM event into one virtual node; it cannot originate network I/O.

name: js_event_size
semantics: Returns the next owner realm event JSON byte size, zero if empty.

name: js_event_read
semantics: Pops the next owner realm console, error, completion or DOM mutation event.

name: js_realm_destroy
semantics: Terminates and releases an owner ECMAScript worker realm.

name: image_decode
semantics: Asynchronously decodes owner-supplied image bytes without receiving a URL or network capability.

name: image_draw
semantics: Alpha-composites a decoded owner image into the caller framebuffer.

name: image_release
semantics: Releases one decoded image owned by the calling runtime.

name: web_renderer_create
semantics: Creates a network-denied WebView render surface; Tauri maps owner-supplied bytes to one stable localhost origin partition per target origin.

name: web_renderer_resource
semantics: Transfers one owner-fetched subresource into the isolated renderer; the renderer receives no socket or URL-fetch capability.

name: web_renderer_commit
semantics: Commits owner bytes to a stable native origin with external network denied; non-Tauri contexts explicitly fall back to opaque srcdoc.

name: web_renderer_set_bounds
semantics: Positions the renderer over an owner-defined framebuffer rectangle.

name: web_renderer_show
semantics: Shows or hides one owner render surface without changing its resource authority.

name: web_renderer_event_size
semantics: Returns the next isolated renderer event JSON size.

name: web_renderer_event_read
semantics: Reads navigation, console, error, lifecycle or blocked-network events emitted by the isolated renderer.

name: web_renderer_request_body_size
semantics: Returns the byte size of a renderer request body captured without granting renderer network authority.

name: web_renderer_request_body_read
semantics: Copies a captured fetch/XHR body into the owner WASM so its packet stack can construct the request.

name: web_renderer_open_devtools
semantics: Requests the native Tauri/WebView2 inspector for the current renderer without changing network ownership.

name: web_renderer_fetch_respond
semantics: Completes a renderer fetch request using status, MIME and body bytes obtained by the owner WASM HTTP stack.

name: web_renderer_protocol_dispatch
semantics: Dispatches protocol events and owner-supplied bytes from a WASM protocol engine into its isolated renderer.

name: web_renderer_destroy
semantics: Destroys one render surface and revokes every object URL created from owner bytes.
